name: API Layer
description: FastAPI router modules under web/routers/ implementing the domain-specific REST and HTMX UI endpoints (visits, activities, arms, epochs, elements, amendments, estimands, terminology browsers, freezes, USDM/DAIR export, and more).

name: Presentation Layer
description: Jinja2/HTMX HTML templates and static assets (CSS, JS, help pages) that render the SoA Workbench UI and are swapped into the page by router responses.

name: Types Layer
description: Pydantic request/response models in web/schemas.py, imported across nearly all routers to validate and shape API payloads.

name: Service Layer
description: Shared business-logic helpers and the cross-cutting audit trail (web/utils.py, web/audit.py) that routers call into for common operations and before/after change logging.

name: Data Layer
description: SQLite persistence: the canonical connection helper (db.py), schema initialization, and migration runner that every router and generator depends on for storage.

name: Configuration Layer
description: Application bootstrap and settings: the FastAPI app factory/lifespan wiring (app.py) and CDISC CT codelist configuration (codelist_config.py) that drive UI dropdown behavior.

name: CLI / Legacy Pipeline Layer
description: The original normalize/expand/validate command-line pipeline (cli.py, normalization.py, schedule.py, validation.py) and the package root, still used by the web layer's USDM generation flows.

name: Integration Layer
description: The Model Context Protocol server (mcp/server.py) that exposes SoA Workbench data and operations as tools for external MCP clients.
